diagram.name: Conceptual Architecture: Holistic SAP Multi-Agent AI on Google Cloud

mxCell.value: Conceptual Architecture: Holistic SAP Multi-Agent AI on Google Cloud
Operating at the Capability & Boundary Level: Highlighting Intent, Business Value, and Domain Relationships without Infrastructure Mechanics.
The 4 Canonical Conceptual Flows: Experience, Value Stream, Domain Data & Enterprise Integration

User Journey Flow (Experience Flow)
Persona interaction & primary objectives (no session/web server mechanics)
Business & Technical Personas engage via multimodal touchpoints (Web, Workspace, IDE) to formulate intent and dispatch strategic goals to autonomous agents.

Business Process Flow (Value Stream)
Business capability coordination, domain events, and milestones
Maps value stream progression: Inquiry Analysis → Agent Delegation (Pro-Code / Joule) → Policy & Guardrail Validation → Core Transactional Settlement.

Domain Data Flow
Macroscopic information movement across bounded contexts
Shows macroscopic data movement: Raw Enterprise Telemetry → Cortex Semantic Foundation → BigQuery Lakehouse → Real-Time Agent Grounding Context.

Enterprise Integration Flow
Coarse-grained boundary handoffs to external ecosystems & ERPs
Defines architectural boundary handoffs: Agent-to-Agent (A2A), MCP protocol bridges, and NetWeaver REST/OData gateways to SAP BTP, SaaS, and S/4HANA.
